title: Config-Driven PySpark ETL Framework
problem: New ETL jobs were built one-off per source, duplicating logic and slowing delivery.
approach: Designed a reusable framework where a pipeline is defined by configuration — source, schema, transformation rules, target — with built-in validation, reconciliation, and Bash-driven job execution.
outcome: Became the standard pattern for new batch pipelines on the team, with consistent validation and logging by default.

title: Legacy Warehouse Migration & ETL Modernization
problem: 15+ legacy reporting workflows on an older warehouse/BI platform needed to move onto a modern Hadoop-based stack without breaking downstream reporting.
approach: Translated legacy SQL and ETL logic into HiveQL- and Informatica BDM-based pipelines, with validation and reconciliation built into every migration before cutover.
outcome: 15+ datasets modernized with preserved data consistency and reporting continuity.

title: Large-Scale ETL & Reporting Pipeline Delivery
problem: Business reporting depended on 30+ ETL workflows running on daily, monthly, quarterly, and custom-date SLAs.
approach: Built and optimized workflows with configurable runtime parameters and partition-based loading; tuned HiveQL/Impala SQL for scale.
outcome: Reliable, SLA-compliant delivery across a large, varied pipeline portfolio.

title: Data Validation, Reconciliation & RCA
problem: Modernized and enhanced pipelines needed provably trustworthy output before stakeholders could rely on them.
approach: Standard validation/reconciliation checks plus root-cause analysis for production issues — 15+ complex enhancement and data-issue requests resolved end to end.
outcome: Issues caught and fixed at the source, with validated production deployments.
